risk_note: RV2 (orders/**, platform/events/**). Order platform status updates: mapped events through the generated transitionOrderPlatform with row_version CAS and status history; backward (P10) and out-of-table transitions write order_sync_pending without touching any orders column and enqueue order.illegal_transition in the same transaction (BR-ATTR-01 ⑦, BR-FUND-01 P10), the P10-off path updates and still enqueues; unmapped codes only go to pending; attribution-parameter change and binding conflict enqueue order.attr_param_changed / order.attr_binding_conflict; alerts and domain events share the injected events bus, a failed enqueue rolls back; alert payloads carry no buyer parameters. Settlement receives the mapped event and raw status as a source argument (rights vs punish). No rebate_status writes. Event names registered per 02 §11 at SPEC_REF 99cc36f (couli#125, test-change #707).
